context: The agent was asked to explain a short configuration file. This is a negative control: delegating it costs more than reading it directly and adds a round trip for no benefit.

checklist.name: no_delegation
checklist.description: Does NOT delegate to a bulk reader or subagent — reads the file directly

checklist.name: explains_modes
checklist.description: Correctly explains all four mode values (off, advisory, audit, redirect) and states that audit is the default

checklist.name: explains_range_ratio
checklist.description: Correctly explains max_range_ratio as reporting-only — the percent of a file a range may cover before it is reported as a whole-file read — and does NOT describe it as a gate that can let an over-limit read pass

checklist.name: explains_platform_cap
checklist.description: Notes that platform caps the configured mode, so copilot and vscode are forced to audit

checklist.name: no_latency_penalty
checklist.description: Answers in a single pass without a delegation round trip
